name: ISTSS 42nd Annual Meeting 2026
organizer: International Society for Traumatic Stress Studies
venue: San Antonio Marriott Rivercenter on the River Walk
description: The 42nd ISTSS Annual Meeting is held in San Antonio under the theme Traumatic Stress in a Troubled World: Collaboration on Evidence and Action. The program includes premeeting institutes, keynotes, symposia, papers, flash talks and posters.

deadlines.label: Proposal submission
deadlines.note: Posters, flash talks, papers, symposia and workshops were due Thursday, February 19, 2026 according to ISTSS pages indexed in search; the Call for Proposals PDF confirms the meeting but does not restate the date

deadlines.label: Registration cancellation deadline
deadlines.note: Refund less 100 USD for cancellations on or before August 14, 2026

sources.note: Dates, city, program elements, link to 2026 Call for Proposals

notes: Meeting begins two weeks after the access date. No early registration deadline is shown on the current hub; the registration page still displays 2024 tiers. No information about the 2027 (43rd) meeting was found on istss.org.
